Run a benchmark

Source: R/run.R
run_benchmark.Rd

Sends every case to the system under test, grades the answer, and records the input, the output, the verdict and the time taken.

Usage

run_benchmark(
  suite,
  runner,
  repeats = 1L,
  study_id = "agent",
  environment = "DEV",
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

suite

An `r4agent_suite`.

runner

A function taking a single character input and returning the answer as a character string. Anything that can be called from R can be put behind this: an HTTP endpoint, a local model, a shell command.

repeats

Integer. How many times to run each case.

study_id

Character. Passed to the run context, and named this way because the evidence schema comes from the clinical submission side of R4SUB. Use the name of the system under test.

environment

One of "DEV", "UAT", "PROD".

quiet

Suppress the progress bar.

Value

An object of class `r4agent_run`.

Details

`repeats` is not a convenience. A system asked the same question five times and answering differently on the third is a support problem waiting to happen, and a suite run once per case can never show it. The default of one keeps a quick run quick; raise it when consistency is part of the question.

Examples

suite <- agent_suite(list(
  agent_case("a1", "2 + 2?", "4", grader = "contains", why = "Arithmetic.")
))
run_benchmark(suite, function(x) "the answer is 4", quiet = TRUE)
#> 
#> ── Benchmark: agent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 1 case, 1 repeat, 1 run
#> First pass: 1 pass, 0 warn, 0 fail
#> Median 0s, p95 0s
